svg.title: Reach it, then turn, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the two Lesson 3-1 tests on a 3 by 3 taped grid. In step 1 the robot starts on a segment of the middle column, facing the next intersection. It follows the line until both sensors reach the intersection, which flashes, then drives forward until its wheels sit on it, and stops. In step 2 it does the same from the same spot, then turns clockwise in place on the intersection and stops facing along the crossing line to the right. Beside it, the steps of each test, with the one running highlighted.
svg.text: Reach it, then turn, from above
The arrival pair: track until the sensors
reach the intersection, then drive past
so the wheels sit on it. Parked there,
the robot can pivot onto the crossing line.
